league.team_name: i'd have a dart (formerly Ryan Lost the Championship)

scoring.kicker: PAT 1, PAT miss -1, FG miss -2, FG 0.1/yd
scoring.dst: ONLY return/defensive TDs 6, safety 1, 2pt return 2 — no sacks/INT/points-allowed scoring

deadlines.lineup_lock: each player's kickoff; compute the first lock each week from the real schedule (Week 1 opens Wed)

rules.autonomy: propose -> Colby approves -> submit; never auto-submit
rules.twelve_hour_rule: if deadline < 12h away, tell Colby to submit in the ESPN app; log submitted_by=human

log_convention.why: The Google Drive connector can create files but cannot edit existing ones. Never append, rewrite, trash, or delete; write one new file per run. The desktop bridge (bridge/sync_logs.py) merges every file into the repo by id twice daily.
log_convention.decisions: decisions-<run_id>.jsonl  (run_id = YYYYMMDD-<routine>, e.g. 20260915-tue). One JSON object per line, schema per schema_ref.
log_convention.sessions: sessions-<run_id>.jsonl (exactly one line; use ts_start, not ts).
log_convention.scores: scores-<run_id>.jsonl (Monday only): {decision_id, scored_at, pts_rec, pts_action, pts_optimal, pts_espn_choice, hindsight_optimal, category}. Latest file wins per decision_id.
log_convention.human_replies: replies-<run_id>.jsonl: {decision_id, ts, choice, followed, override_reason, submitted_by}. Written when Colby replies in the routine session.
log_convention.approvals: approval-<decision_id>.json: {decision_id, move, deadline, approved_at, status}. status approved|submitted|expired; a later file with the same decision_id supersedes. Stays on Drive; consumed by the desktop-sync session.
log_convention.playbook_additions: playbook-add-<run_id>.md (Monday). The bridge appends it to the repo playbook.md.
log_convention.reading: Reference material (config, playbook, standing answers, schema, canonical decisions.jsonl) comes from repo_raw_base. From Drive read only what has not reached the repo yet: approval-*.json, replies-*.jsonl, and decisions-*.jsonl whose ids are absent from decisions_ref.
